name: contextum
description: Brings opt-in live device context into ChatGPT and Codex through Contextum.

interface.shortDescription: Live opt-in context from your device
interface.longDescription: Contextum lets ChatGPT and Codex read a temporary, user-authorized snapshot from the user's device, including coordinates, GPS accuracy, movement data, an active note, runtime state, and snapshot freshness.
defaultPrompt: Consultá mi contexto actual y decime qué tan reciente es.
Usá Contextum para leer mi ubicación y estado actual.
